blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos and his family were praised by US President Donald Trump for a warm welcome for him and in doing a good job organizing the recent summit, adding that the Philippine leader got his good genes from his parents. In his speech for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-US Special Summit on Thursday night, Trump said he does not want to “date” himself or reveal his age, but he said he knew Marcos’ parents very well. Marcos is the only son of former President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. and former First Lady Imelda Marcos—both of whom have […]...
